scenario: Run weather-qml on one V1.2 sample. In one process, render the initial QML value of 21 C, submit an update to -8, and sample the process RSS once.
expected: The renderer completes the initial scene presentation and a second presentation after the temperature update.
observed: Two presentations completed in one process, first for the initial 21 C value and then after the -8 update. One RSS sample measured 468 KiB. The operator has not confirmed that -8 was visible on screen.
limits: One reported V1.2 sample, one process and one RSS sample are covered; the RSS value is not a peak measurement.
The completion of both presentations does not establish the visible appearance of the -8 update.
This QML run is separate from the LVGL display observation; the LVGL screen confirmation does not apply to this result.
